patch_description:
The fixed optimizer uses Adam with learning rate 0.03, batches of 15, 30 steps per epoch, validation-loss early stopping, three uploads, and two independently parameterized ansatz repeats per upload. The current block has four shared parameters but places all 28 commuting CZ gates together, limiting nonlinear processing and converging only after about 270 steps.

The proposed block retains the complete K8 interaction graph but partitions it into three balanced, dihedrally regular edge groups. Collective RY and RX mixers are inserted between these groups, so uploaded phases are repeatedly converted into populations before subsequent interactions. All rotations remain shared across eight wires, yielding only six parameters per block and 38 total parameters including readout. This matches the parameter count and gate count of the strongest prior architecture while distributing its middle mixer across two entangling stages for greater effective depth and improved gradient flow.
